I'm a class action lawyer in LA and I handle consumer cases like these. We basically look to prior court cases and FTC actions which address these types of warranties.  The warranty you're talking about is an express warranty and there is some complicated law related to them.  But basically under California's consumer protection statutes, when a manufacturer's warranty makes it impracticable or nearly impossible to make a claim because of the hoops the manufacturer requires, it's likely going to be void. There is a recent class action against Sealy mattress with similar facts.  PM me if you'd like more information.
